_doc: Copy to bible/series/<series>/episodes/<ep>/after-post.json (the writer owns it). All keys optional: a missing or gate-failing text falls back to the template bank in tools/after_post.py. No tashkeel, no link, no digit or fixed word to type, one question mark at most, under 220 characters. Never a poll on the two choices (votes are read from reel comments only).
